# A09 report: Inbox, follow-ups, outcomes and the learning engine

Branch `v2-a09-inbox`. The code is in `server/inbox/**` and `server/learning/**`, plus an addition to `server/services/mailer.ts`. Tests and fixtures:

- `scripts/checks/a09-inbox.ts`
- `scripts/a09/` (the shared scenario and the fixture recorder)
- `fixtures/mail/a09-*.eml` (24 emails)
- `fixtures/claude/{inbox_classify,learning_plan,gap_report}/*.json` (7 recordings)

No contract was changed. My requests are in `docs/build/requests/A09.md`.

## What was built

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `inbox/imap.ts` | The mailbox seam. `ImapSource` uses `imapflow` and is read-only: Bureau never moves, flags or deletes mail. It requires TLS (implicit, or STARTTLS enforced with `doSTARTTLS`), turns logging off, caps message size at 3 MB and fetches incrementally by UID. `idleOnce()` waits with IMAP IDLE. `EmlSource` is a fake mailbox made of `.eml` files, used by tests and by local development through `BUREAU_INBOX_EML_DIR`. `testConnection()` logs in, lists folders and counts messages, with an injectable opener. Errors are mapped to plain messages, and credentials never appear in them. |
| `inbox/settings.ts` | Mailbox settings. The app password goes in the vault as `imap_password`, never in settings or a response. Changing the account or folder resets the UID cursor. |
| `inbox/parse.ts` | `mailparser` turns raw mail into the fields the inbox uses: Message-ID, thread ids, sender, text (HTML converted), links, auto-reply and bulk flags. Attachments are ignored. |
| `inbox/rules.ts` | Free pre-rules and extraction: verification codes and magic links, dates, deadlines (written or relative, such as "within 7 days"), scheduling and assessment links, the sender's company, and prompt-injection detection. It settles 19 of the 24 fixtures without a model call. |
| `inbox/classify.ts` | The `inbox_classify` task (Haiku), only for what the rules leave open. The email is fenced as untrusted data. The model picks the class and writes the summary and the recruiter's questions. Codes, links and dates always come from code. The model's company is kept only if the email names it. Deadlines must be plausible. Suspicious mail is capped at 0.5 confidence and flagged for review. If the model is unavailable, the code's best guess is used and flagged for review. |
| `inbox/link.ts` | Links a message to an application. Signals: thread (a reply to mail we sent, using A08's journaled Message-ID or our follow-ups, or a reply to an already linked message), sender domain matching the company's own domains, the ATS family, links back to the exact posting or board, and the company name and job title. Lookalike domains (for example `corvid-careers.example.biz`) are penalised and never linked. Ties between applications are left to the owner. |
| `inbox/stage.ts` | Stages move forward only: applied → screening (a recruiter question or assessment) → interview → offer / rejected. A rejection needs confidence of at least 0.75, never overrides an offer, and once an application is rejected only the owner can move it. The v1 `jobs.stage` column is mirrored. `outcomes` rows hold replied, the furthest reply class and days to the first reply, and emit `application.outcome`. Silence rows (`replied = 0`) are written after 21 days. |
| `inbox/codes.ts` | Codes and links are held in memory only. They are handed out once and expire 15 minutes after Bureau sees them. Matching is by host, by registrable domain, or by ATS family plus tenant: the Workday subdomain, the Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board slug, or the company name. |
| `inbox/pipeline.ts` | Handles one message: parse → classify → link → store → act. |
| `inbox/messages.ts` | Storage and queries. `inbox_messages.data` holds the `ClassifiedMessage` contract plus working fields. `code` is always null in the database, and verification mail keeps no links or preview. |
| `inbox/followup.ts` | One follow-up per application, sent after N days. N is the campaign's `followUpDays`, or 7 by default. All of these must hold: the address is published in the posting and is not a no-reply or ATS robot, there was no reply and no rejection, the campaign is active, the kill switch is off, and the daily cap (default 3) has room. Before sending, an `intent` row is journaled, so a crash can never cause a second send. Dry-run campaigns record a `rehearsed` row instead of sending. The draft comes from A04's `draftFollowUp`. `NotImplemented` means no follow-ups today, logged once a day. |
| `inbox/index.ts` | `pollInbox()` is single-flight and batched. It keeps the UID cursor, survives a UIDVALIDITY change, re-runs effects that never finished, and runs follow-ups (hourly) and silence outcomes (daily) on A08's 5-minute poll. `waitForCode(domain, timeoutMs)` registers a waiter and watches the mailbox while anyone waits: IDLE when available, otherwise a poll every 15 s. |
| `inbox/deps.ts`, `inbox/ai.ts`, `inbox/url.ts` | Injectable seams for notify, the planner, the answer bank, unknown questions, A04's drafter and the mail sender, plus the Claude client. `fenceMail()` fences email text. Deep links come from `BUREAU_PUBLIC_URL`, an extra allowed origin, or localhost. |
| `inbox/schema.ts` | The `inbox_followups` table and indexes. They are additive and created on import, so `db.ts` is untouched. |
| `learning/plan.ts` | The `learning_plan` task. Gaps come from A02's stored requirements (missing or partial, in importance order), not from the model. Legal gates such as citizenship, degrees and years of experience are excluded. Inputs: A03's cached research brief for the company's stack, the posting (fenced) and the candidate's real experience. Plan length is the days to the interview, clamped to 1–14 (5 if unknown). Each day has tasks, free resources and a mini project; the plan also has likely questions and talking points. Resources must be `https`, free, not paywalled and not behind URL shorteners. If the model is unavailable, a code-built plan is used: one gap a day with official docs, then a review day. A plan made for the same application and date in the last 14 days is reused. |
| `learning/gaps.ts` + `learning/skills.ts` | The weekly gap report. Counting is code: a lexicon of about 100 skills, plus normalised leftover requirements. Soft skills, degrees and years are dropped. Each requirement is weighted by job score × importance × (1 if missing, 0.5 if partial), and each job counts once per skill. The `gap_report` task only merges near-duplicates and suggests weekend projects, citing the code's ids; invented ids are ignored and counts always come from code. There is one row per period, and a rebuild replaces it. With the opt-in setting (off by default), the top 3 gaps are added to the learning list as `queued`. Nothing already being learned is ever demoted. |
| `learning/index.ts` | `buildLearningPlan()` and `buildGapReport()`, both with the stub signatures. Also `learningCommand(args)` for Telegram `/learning`. |
| `services/mailer.ts` | Adds `sendPlainEmail()` for follow-ups: a plain-text reply with In-Reply-To support and no attachment. Sending is refused in replay or offline mode, and the sender is swappable for tests. |

### What happens on each class

| Class | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `verification_code` | The code or link is held in memory for `waitForCode`. Only codes under 15 minutes old are held. The message is not linked to an application. |
| `confirmation_received` | Linked to the application. No stage change. Not counted as a reply. |
| `rejection` | Stage → rejected. Outcome recorded. Blocks any follow-up. |
| `recruiter_question` | Stage → screening. Outcome recorded. If every question is answered by the answer bank with confidence of at least 0.85, a reply is drafted and queued for the owner; it is never sent. Unanswered questions go to A03's unknown-question queue. An `info` notification is sent. |
| `assessment` / `interview_invite` | Stage → screening or interview. Outcome recorded. A learning plan is built, with the alert waiting up to 60 s for it. Then `notify('alert')` sends what they asked, the deadline, the booking or assessment link and the plan link, and `alert.interview` is emitted with `planId`. A slow plan follows later as an `info` notification. |
| `offer` | Stage → offer. Outcome recorded. Immediate alert, with no plan. |
| `other` | Stored only. Suspicious (injection or lookalike) mail produces an `info` notification ("held for review") and no effects at all. |

Bureau never replies to anyone. The only outgoing mail is a follow-up.

## Routes

| Method | Path | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/inbox/settings` | Mailbox settings. Never returns the password; `password.set` says whether one is stored. |
| PUT | `/api/inbox/settings` | Save settings (partial). `password` goes to the vault. |
| DELETE | `/api/inbox/settings` | Forget the password and stop polling. |
| POST | `/api/inbox/test` | Test the connection. The body may carry unsaved settings and a password. |
| GET | `/api/inbox/status` | Last poll, last error, counts by class (all and this week), unlinked and review counts, codes held and waiting (counts only), follow-ups today. |
| POST | `/api/inbox/poll` | Poll now. |
| GET | `/api/inbox/messages` | List (`?class=a,b&applicationId=&unlinked=1&review=1&q=&since=&limit=&offset=`). |
| GET | `/api/inbox/messages/:id` | One message. |
| PUT | `/api/inbox/messages/:id` | Owner correction (`{ class?, applicationId? }`). Re-applies stage and outcome. |
| GET | `/api/inbox/drafts` | Drafted recruiter replies and unanswered questions. |
| POST | `/api/inbox/drafts/:id/done` · `/dismiss` | Mark a draft as sent by the owner, or throw it away. |
| GET | `/api/inbox/followups` | Follow-up log, plus who is due, waiting or blocked, and why. |
| POST | `/api/inbox/followups/run` | Send the follow-ups that are due now, within today's cap. |
| PUT | `/api/inbox/stage/:applicationId` | Set an application's stage by hand (`{ stage }`). |
| GET | `/api/learning/plans` | Plans (`?applicationId=&limit=`). |
| GET | `/api/learning/plans/:id` | One plan. |
| POST | `/api/learning/plans` | Build a plan (`{ applicationId, interviewDate?, force? }`). |
| DELETE | `/api/learning/plans/:id` | Delete a plan. |
| GET | `/api/learning/gaps` | Gap reports, newest first. |
| GET | `/api/learning/gaps/latest` | The newest report. |
| GET | `/api/learning/gaps/:id` | One report. |
| POST | `/api/learning/gaps` | Build a report now (`{ period? }`, for example `2026-W45`). |
| GET / PUT | `/api/learning/settings` | `{ autoQueueTopGaps (default false), defaultPlanDays (default 5) }`. |
| POST | `/api/learning/list/queue` | Put a gap skill on A03's learning list as `queued`. Never demotes an existing item. |
| POST | `/api/learning/list/start` | Mark a skill `learning`, adding it if needed. Same as Telegram `/learning`. |
| PUT | `/api/learning/list/:id/status` | Set a learning-list item's status (`learning`, `queued` or `done`). |

The learning list itself stays at A03's `/api/master/learning`.

## How A08's calls are met

- `pollInbox()` returns the number of new messages handled. It returns 0 when no mailbox is set up (it no longer throws), so the 5-minute task stays quiet.
- `buildGapReport(isoWeek(now, tz))` accepts `YYYY-Www`. Reports are stored in `gap_reports` with the `{ skills: [{ skill, count, … }] }` shape the digest reads.
- The digest's inbox section reads `inbox_messages.data.company`, `.summary` and `.deadline`; all three are filled for every class. Rule-decided messages get a code-written summary.

## How to run and test

- `npm run selfcheck -- a09` runs 46 checks in a few seconds, offline. They cover:
  - Parsing and pre-rules on all 24 fixtures, and coverage of every class.
  - Code, link, date and deadline extraction.
  - Injection fencing.
  - The classifier on recorded Haiku responses. A stale recording fails loudly instead of silently falling back.
  - Model-output grounding, and the fallback when the model is unavailable.
  - Linking accuracy (100% on the fixtures), the thread, the lookalike refusal, and ambiguity.
  - `waitForCode`: a Workday code arriving while waiting, a Greenhouse code matched by board slug, an Ashby magic link, one-shot use, no handout to another tenant, timeout, 15-minute expiry.
  - Codes absent from the database, the event log and the bus.
  - The whole pipeline through `pollInbox()`: stages, `jobs.stage` mirroring, outcomes and days to reply, idempotency (second poll, re-delivery, new UIDVALIDITY), seven alerts with the Lumen Pay plan linked, drafts, unknown questions, zero mail sent, injection held.
  - Follow-ups: published contacts only, no A04 means none sent, daily cap, one per application, never after a rejection, the intent journal, the kill switch, the offline mailer.
  - Learning plan on a recorded response (paywalled and `http` resources dropped, reuse), the fallback plan, plan length.
  - The gap report: merge, weights, invented id ignored, one row per period, auto-queue opt-in without demotion.
  - Telegram `/learning`.
  - Routes via Fastify inject, and test-connection with a fake IMAP client.
- `npm run typecheck` is clean. The full `npm run selfcheck` passes: 309 checks, 1 skipped (not mine).
- Re-record the Claude fixtures after changing a prompt or the scenario: `npx tsx scripts/a09/record-fixtures.ts` (`--preview` prints the prompts and writes nothing). The responses are hand-written in that file.
- Local manual run against the fixture mailbox, with no real mailbox:

  ```
  BUREAU_PORT=47914 BUREAU_DATA_DIR=<temp> BUREAU_REPLAY=1 BUREAU_NOTIFY_OFFLINE=1 BUREAU_INBOX_EML_DIR=fixtures/mail npx tsx server/index.ts
  ```

  Then get a session from `GET /api/session` and call `POST /api/inbox/poll` with the CSRF header. I did this: 24 handled, the counts by class were correct, the password stayed in the vault, and nothing secret appeared in the server log.
- Using a real mailbox:
  1. Create a dedicated Gmail account, turn on IMAP and create an app password.
  2. `PUT /api/inbox/settings { host: "imap.gmail.com", port: 993, secure: true, user, password }`.
  3. `POST /api/inbox/test`.
  4. `PUT /api/inbox/settings { enabled: true }`.

## Acceptance

- ✅ **Replies update application stages automatically.** Proven in selfcheck on 24 fixture emails across 9 applications, including a kindly worded rejection and a reschedule that starts with "Unfortunately". It has not been run against a real mailbox: the rules forbid connecting to one during development.
- ✅ **An interview leads to a Telegram alert within 5 minutes, with the learning plan linked.** A08 polls every 5 minutes. On an interview or assessment, the inbox builds the plan (waiting at most 60 s) and calls `notify('alert')` with the plan's deep link, then emits `alert.interview` with `planId`. Selfcheck proves this up to `notify()`. Delivery to a real Telegram bot is A08's channel and was not verified with a real bot (A08's report says the same).
- ✅ **Verification codes reach the form engine.** `waitForCode(domain, timeoutMs)` resolves from fixture messages for Workday, Greenhouse and Ashby, is one-shot and tenant-safe, and expires codes after 15 minutes. A05 is built in parallel and does not call it in this worktree yet; see requests §6 for how to call it.
- ✅ **Outcomes feed the writer's bandit.** `outcomes` rows (replied, furthest class, days to the first reply, silence after 21 days) and `application.outcome` events are written and tested. A04 reading them is not verified here, because A04 is not merged.

## Known limits

- IMAP was tested only with fakes: an `.eml` source and a fake client for test-connection. IDLE and the real `imapflow` paths have not run against a server. Gmail OAuth is not built; IMAP with an app password is.
- No follow-up is sent until A04's `draftFollowUp` lands; `NotImplemented` is treated as "none today". The dry-run (`rehearsed`) path relies on A08's `isDryRun` and has no selfcheck of its own.
- Hiring contacts come only from the posting text (requests §4).
- Times are kept as written ("15:00 PKT" becomes `2026-11-12T15:00`), without converting the time zone.
- The pre-rules are English. Other languages fall through to the model, which handles them but costs a Haiku call.
- Learning-plan resource URLs are filtered (https, free, no paywall, no shorteners) but not fetched to check they are live.
- Two applications at the same company with identical evidence are left unlinked for the owner (`/api/inbox/messages?unlinked=1` and `PUT /api/inbox/messages/:id`).
- Recruiter-reply drafts are listed in the API and announced with an `info` notification. They appear in the digest only once A08 adds them (requests §2).
